title: Dark Green Crypto Finance App Screens
whatItIs: Three phones with white bezels on a black-green field with a ghost brand name: a home with balance, request and send buttons, recent recipients and transactions; a send money screen with recipient, amount and keypad; and a received bitcoin screen with details and a lime button.
whatItMeans: Dark green gradient screens with lime buttons feel modern and secure, and consistent cards keep the flow calm.
techniques: Dark green gradient header on each screen
Dark rounded cards and keypad keys
Green and red amounts for positive and negative
Ghost brand name behind the phones

vocabulary.definition: A grid of number keys for entering an amount.
A row of recent contacts for quick sending.
Oversized faint text behind a scene.
